name: No Working Script
hint: If a sequence of blocks does not start with an event block, it can never be executed.
instruction: Connect your sequence of blocks to an event block to start your program.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
forever :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
move (1) steps
turn left (5) degrees
end

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked :: #007000 //⇦  👍
forever
move (1) steps
turn left (5) degrees
end
